rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement lets a skill link to files for specialized material, but each such link must say when to read the file. The file has three links of that kind, and each one says when:
- `[CI example](references/ci.md)`: the text says to use it "when adding these steps to an existing workflow", and also covers setting up or reviewing project CI.
- `[references/distributed-requirements.md]`: the text says to read it "before drafting" an obligation that applies separately at each of many sites, and "whenever you edit a `{req}` that contains `{sites}` or `{violations}`".
- `[references/syntax-details.md]`: the text says to read it "If a file that implements or tests a requirement cannot carry a comment ... or a requirement lives in a nested chapter".

The mention of `references/fixme.md` is inside a code span and is not a Markdown link. It also says what the file is for, in the habeas-evidence skill. No other links to supporting files exist. The site meets the requirement.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
